title: test_suite_summary.md

canonical_node.axiom: The test suite summary file is the authoritative record of test pass/fail status and timing for the Biblical Empirical Suite.
definitions: test_suite_summary.json: a JSON file consolidating results from individual test0X_results.json files.
PASSED: a test status indicating the test met its criteria.
Biblical Empirical Suite: tests 03 through 09 as described in the document.
derivation: The document states it is the master summary file for the Biblical Empirical Suite.
It provides a consolidated pass/fail record with timing data.
The JSON content lists seven tests (03-09) all with status PASSED.
The document interprets total_passed: 9 as including 2 JAX Field Theory tests.
The document claims the suite runs in under 2.5 seconds total.
canonical_node.action: Treat test_suite_summary.json as the canonical record of test outcomes; use it to answer whether tests passed and to report timing.
boundary: Does not provide detailed test results; those are in individual test0X_results.json files.
Does not include full JAX suite results; those are recorded elsewhere.
Does not define test criteria or methodology.
test: Check that test_suite_summary.json exists and contains the expected fields.
Verify that the statuses match the individual test result files.
Verify that the timing values are consistent with the described test durations.

dg1_dependencies: Individual test0X_results.json files for each test (03-09).
JAX Field Theory test results for the additional two tests.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a single consolidated summary of test outcomes and timing for the entire Biblical Empirical Suite.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the pass/fail status and timing information from individual test results.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this summary, there is no single authoritative record of the suite's overall pass/fail status; one would need to inspect each individual result file.

overstatement_risks: The document claims 'biblical proof receipt' which is an overstatement; it is a test summary, not proof of any theological claim.
The total_passed count of 9 includes tests not detailed in the document, which could be misleading without full context.
kill_conditions: If individual test result files do not match the summary statuses.
If the timing data is fabricated or inconsistent.
risk.lean_target: A JSON schema validator for test_suite_summary.json

plain_summary: This document is a summary file for a test suite, listing pass/fail statuses and timing. It is a record of empirical tests, not a proof of any theological claim. The summary is coherent but should not be overinterpreted.
